Card Q&A.a: It can play 1 [Mineral] trait Digimon card with a play cost of 5 or less, or it can play 1 [Rock] trait Digimon card with a play cost of 5 or less.
Card Q&A.q: What cards can be played using this card's [On Deletion] effect?

Effect: [On Deletion] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. You may play 1 [Mineral] or [Rock] trait Digimon card with a play cost of 5 or less among them without paying the cost. Trash the rest.
Inherited Effect: [Opponent's Turn] [Once Per Turn] When one of your opponent's Digimon attacks, you may change the attack target to this Digimon.
